Haplotype block table from a set of target loci

Source: R/hgsi-blocks.R
hbr_haplotype_block_table.Rd

Runs [hbr_haplotype_blocks()] and returns the block summary table alongside the per-locus assignment. The table has one row per block with the block id, chromosome, start and end position in cM, the number of target loci in the block, the number of distinct genes (when `units` has a `gene` column) and the concatenated gene and trait names.

Usage

hbr_haplotype_block_table(
  plink_prefix = NULL,
  units,
  cm_snp = NULL,
  chr_snp = NULL,
  traits = NULL,
  method = c("recomb", "ld", "either", "fourgamete", "gabriel", "recomb+gabriel",
    "recomb+fourgamete"),
  flank_cM = 1,
  max_snps = 400L,
  max_span_cM = 5,
  min_gamete = 0.01,
  maf_min = 0.05,
  rmax = 0.01,
  r2 = 0.5,
  ld_max_cM = 3,
  r2_min = 0.25,
  gabriel_grid = 21L,
  carry = NULL
)

Arguments

plink_prefix

Character. PLINK file prefix. Required by the SNP-level methods (`"fourgamete"`, `"gabriel"`) and their combinations; ignored otherwise.

units

Data.frame with columns `chr` and `cm`, and optionally `snp_col` (PLINK column index of the locus's own SNP, needed by `"fourgamete"` and `"gabriel"`).

cm_snp

Numeric vector of genetic positions per SNP in the PLINK file. Required by the SNP-level methods.

chr_snp

Character vector of chromosomes per SNP in the PLINK file. Required by the SNP-level methods.

traits

Optional character vector (one per row of `units`) of the trait(s) each locus belongs to. When `units` already carries a `traits` column, that is used instead.

method

Block method, one of `"recomb"`, `"ld"`, `"either"`, `"fourgamete"`, `"gabriel"`, `"recomb+gabriel"`, `"recomb+fourgamete"`.

flank_cM

Numeric. Window (+/- cM) around each cluster of target loci from which SNPs are read, for SNP-level methods.

max_snps

Integer. Maximum SNPs per cluster after thinning.

max_span_cM

Numeric. Largest distance between the first and last locus of a block (cM). Chaining cannot build blocks longer than this.

min_gamete

Numeric. Four-gamete frequency that counts as evidence of recombination (Haploview default 0.01).

maf_min

Numeric. Minimum minor allele frequency for a SNP to enter the block search.

rmax

Numeric. Maximum recombination fraction between neighbouring loci for `"recomb"` and `"either"` (default 0.01, about 1 cM).

r2

Numeric. Minimum r^2 of carrier indicators to join neighbours under `"ld"` and `"either"`.

ld_max_cM

Numeric. Largest distance over which LD may join neighbours (cM).

r2_min

Numeric. Reserved for a future version; currently not wired into the SNP-level block callers (the four-gamete rule and the full Gabriel D' test are applied directly to every pair).

gabriel_grid

Integer. Reserved for a future version; currently not wired into the SNP-level block callers.

carry

Logical matrix individuals x target loci. Required by `"ld"` and `"either"`; ignored otherwise.

Value

A list with `blocks` (the summary table) and `assignment` (the block id per target locus, in the same order as `units`).

Examples

units <- data.frame(chr = c("1", "1", "1"),
                    cm  = c(10, 10.5, 11),
                    gene = c("g1", "g2", "g3"))
hbr_haplotype_block_table(method = "recomb", units = units)
#> $blocks
#>   block chr start_cM end_cM n_target_haplotypes n_genes    genes traits
#> 1 HB001   1       10     11                   3       3 g1;g2;g3     NA
#>   panel_freq
#> 1         NA
#> 
#> $assignment
#> [1] 1 1 1
#>
